==Hero Usage==
* Heroes cast Protective Spirit in response to any amount of incoming damage, even if that damage is below the threshold needed for Protective Spirit to reduce it.

== Notes ==
* This skill is the base for all [[55 Monk]] builds.
* [[Spirit Bond]] and Protective Spirit stack to great effect.  Even if Protective Spirit would [[Damage reduction|reduce damage]] taken to below 50, as long as the initial damage (before reduction from Protective Spirit) is above 50, Spirit Bond will still take effect. This is the basis for the "[[600]]" monk in the 600/smite team used for farming.
* The concise description is more accurate than the verbose one: damage from [[signet]]s and [[trap]]s for example will also be reduced.
* [[Life stealing]] and [[health loss]] is not reduced.

== Trivia ==
* When casting this spell, the image that appears over the head of the caster resembles the Hindu god [[W:Shiva|Shiva]].
